Definition: Chen, a figurative name for an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Hen is named once, in Zechariah, among the men whose names are set on the crown laid up as a memorial in the temple of the Lord. His name sits beside Helem, Tobijah and Jedaiah, men who had come from the exile bringing silver and gold for the crowning of Joshua the high priest.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a single name kept in the temple record matters, because God remembers the men who honour His house.
